name: obhrm-brain-trust
description: OBHRM multi-agent knowledge team linking a 12-chapter textbook with 145 theories, 601 scales and 108 R methods: a lead orchestrator routes each concept query to three specialist agents and assembles one complete four-library answer.

displayDescription.zh: 查组织行为学的理论、量表与分析方法：一个概念、四库联查、一次给全，附教材出处与可信度标注。
displayDescription.en: Look up OBHRM theories, scales and analysis methods: one concept, four libraries searched together, delivered complete with textbook anchors and credibility flags.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 查「情绪劳动」：教材出处、相关理论、测量量表与分析方法，一次给全。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Look up "emotional labor": textbook anchor, relevant theories, established scales and analysis methods, all in one pass.

quickPrompts.zh: 查「情绪劳动」：教材出处、相关理论、测量量表与分析方法，一次给全。
quickPrompts.en: Look up "emotional labor": textbook anchor, relevant theories, established scales and analysis methods, all in one pass.

quickPrompts.zh: 工作绩效有哪些成熟量表？给出维度、题数、计分方式与出处。
quickPrompts.en: What established scales measure job performance? Give dimensions, item counts, scoring and sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 讲清「情感事件理论」：内容、作用机制、结构与应用，附参考文献。
quickPrompts.en: Explain Affective Events Theory: content, processes, structure and application, with references.
